name: Sika® Showerbond
tagline: SOLVENT BASED GUN GRADE WALLBOARD ADHESIVE
summary: Sika® Showerbond is a solvent based, fast grab, gun grade adhesive. It has been specifically formulated for bonding acrylic plastic shower linings to unpainted gypsum plasterboard, fibre cement sheeting and timber.
metaDescription: Sika® Showerbond is a solvent based, fast grab, gun grade adhesive. It has been specifically formulated for bonding acrylic plastic shower linings to unpainted gypsum plasterboard, fibre cement sheeting and timber.
attributes: Will not damage acrylic plastic shower liners
Panels can be relocated for up to 30 minutes after positioning
Excellent adhesion to most common building materials
Easy to apply and clean up
Recommended and used by leading acrylic fixture manufacturers
usage: Sika® Showerbond is used for bonding acrylic plastic shower linings to suitable wall linings and bonding acrylic shower trays to suitable flooring.

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Eighteen (18) months when stored as stated.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store in original unopened containers in a cool, dry place away from naked flames.

items.label: Movement capability
items.text: Movement accommodation is slight, will accept normal building movement

items.label: Yield
items.text: On average, one cartridge of Sika® Showerbond will supply approx. 12 metres of 5mm x 5mm bead

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: Ensure both surfaces to be bonded are clean, dry and grease free. Cut nozzle on cartridge as shown below so that a 5-6 mm bead will be extruded.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Clean up using a dry clean cloth or Sika® Remover-208.

Reduces squeaking and nail ride in floors
